title: A Holdout's banging heard as one frantic bout (AU1's weak-sound sweep): each banging call plays 2-4 of the bang takes 0.3 s apart, but each take is a whole bout of 5-8 blows, so a call is 12-32 blows piled on each other; and the takes are built so far through the wall (top cut at 1.6 kHz) that the fists on planks are a dull thud
